## About
Consolidated Auto Works is a repair and parts shop for Jaguar automobiles, on SW Multnomah Blvd in Portland.
Barbara and her crew look after Jaguars old and new. One reviewer called us the only Jaguar repair shop they trust. Another said we reminded her of her grandparents' shop doing honest work.
Customers give us 4.8 from 22 Google reviews. If your Jag needs help, give us a call.

## Services
- Jaguar service and repair: Repairs and service for Jaguar automobiles, from getting a car running again to keeping it on the road.
- Jaguar parts: We're a parts facility for Jaguars as well as a repair shop.
- Vintage Jaguar repair: One reviewer comes to us for repairs and service on vintage Jaguars.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Thursday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Friday, Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you work on vintage Jaguars?
A: Yes. One reviewer brings us their vintage Jaguars for repairs and service.

Q: How do I reach the shop?
A: Call 503.246.8477 or email barbara@consolidatedautoworks.com. You'll find us on SW Multnomah Blvd in Portland, OR 97219.
